note: Quiet, aggregator-dominated week. Full boolean sweep across all five search clusters (freelance PR/consultant, communications/media-relations consultant + contract, fractional/interim communications, outsourced/white-label PR, earned-media/publicist contractor) via LinkedIn (Google-indexed), Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Mediabistro, The PR Net, Fractional Jobs, and gofractional. The vast majority of results were platform/aggregator pages (Upwork, Toptal, The Work Crowd, Thirdwork, ZipRecruiter salary data) and recruiter-network landing pages rather than distinct employer briefs. The Fractional Jobs board carried NO live PR/comms roles this week (all Finance, Engineering, Sales, Growth-marketing). The Mediabistro 'hot jobs' feature was March-dated and social/production-focused, not PR. The strongest freelance postings that did surface (The Work Crowd fintech/blockchain networks, JIH PR) were already captured in the prior 7 days and deduplicated out. One genuinely new qualifying senior brief: Four Pines Fund's Fractional Director of Communications. Reported honestly rather than padding with weak or duplicate leads.

leads.notes: STRONGEST NEW LEAD THIS WEEK, Grade B (combined 60). Senior fractional comms brief — a very clean match to Mark's strategic + executional freelance operator profile: they want someone to conduct a comprehensive comms assessment, build a strategic plan in the first 4–5 months, then run day-to-day execution and ongoing management. Requires 7+ years building/leading comms functions. SECTOR CAVEAT: this is a national philanthropy focused on systems-change work, NOT a finance / PE / B2B target, so it scores 0 on sector fit and is a relationship/portfolio lead rather than an ICP-core finance target. Do NOT confuse with '4Pines Fund Services LLC' (fourpinesfs.com), a separate fund-administration firm — this is the philanthropy at fourpines.org. PITCH ANGLE: position Mark as a senior fractional comms lead who can stand up the function fast — assessment, messaging architecture, media/earned-media visibility, executive/thought-leadership comms — on a scoped fractional retainer. ACTION: apply via the Daybook listing and/or reach the org through its LinkedIn; treat as a solid B-grade fractional engagement even though sector is off-ICP.
